name: themeparks-web
description: Theme park live ride status, wait times, virtual queues, ride details, best time to ride, park hours, and minute-level ride downtime history from the free ThemeParks.wiki API. Works keyless; an optional free key extends history to 30 days and enables live push. Powered by ThemeParks.wiki. Unofficial; not affiliated with ThemeParks.wiki or any park.

THEMEPARKS_API_KEY.title: ThemeParks.wiki API key (optional)
THEMEPARKS_API_KEY.description: Optional. Leave blank and every tool still works keyless (7 days of history, 60 history calls per hour). A free key extends history to 30 days and 600 calls per hour, and enables live push (themeparks_live mode=watch). Create a free account at https://www.themeparks.wiki/register, then generate a key on https://www.themeparks.wiki/profile. Sent only to api.themeparks.wiki; never logged or shown.
